rounds.text: Valiant Laboratories is currently undergoing a powerful fundamental transformation, evidenced by a 90% compounded sales growth and a 12208% surge in profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E15, E16]. This operational momentum is further validated by a significant expansion in margins, with quarterly operating margins jumping from 5% to 25% year-over-year [E21]. The company has successfully de-risked its balance sheet by slashing borrowings from Rs 122 Cr to Rs 46 Cr, while simultaneously completing major capital expenditure projects, as indicated by the 96.2% reduction in capital work in progress [E30, E31]. Market participants are beginning to recognize this turnaround, as the stock maintains a 100% relative strength rating against the Nifty 500 and trades above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E41, E42]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds including negative operating cash flow, a lack of institutional ownership, and a discounted cash flow model suggesting the stock is overvalued [E25, E33, E36]. Despite these concerns, the company is clearly outperforming expectations, with profit growth exceeding one-year price growth by a ratio of 554.91 [E48].
